description: Data underlying the publication: Component Sizing and Dynamic Simulation of a Low-Emission Power Plant for Cruise Ships is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Berend Van Veldhuizen. This dataset contains the used data and models for an SOFC power plant simulation model. The model contains models for SOFC, gensets, batteries, boilers and an energy management strategy. The time-domain simulation model is made in Matlab Simulink. It reports the fuel consumption and emissions. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
